Overview

How every part of Nota is drawn. This page draws the rules of DESIGN.md live from the theme files: pick a theme at the top and everything follows. Sizes are pixels at 100 % interface scale.

1Keep every controlThe layout and every control stay where they are; only how they are drawn changes.
2A flat, grey shellToolbar, browser, track headers, mixer and editors are flat and grey, so the track colours carry the content.
3Depth only in devicesThe device card is raised, its sections are pressed in, its controls sit in grooves.
4Orange has three jobsSolid for what is live, a soft tint for what you picked, orange lines for values in a device.
5One typefaceGeist for every word and number, with tabular figures. No monospace face, no capital-letter labels.
6Never see-throughAn unavailable option is drawn in ink 4 with nothing picked, never faded.

Colour

Every colour has one job. Four themes are built in; a theme changes values only, never shapes, type, layout or where orange goes.

Click a row to copy its hex for the theme shown. See-through values are #AARRGGBB; their chip is drawn on Panel.

Orange

Orange comes in three strengths, so you can tell at a glance what is playing, what you picked and what a device is set to.

Live: solid

Playing, recording, the playhead and loop, a switch that is on inside a device, power, the current device tab.

Picked: soft tint

The option you chose. A pale fill with orange text or icon. Never solid.

Values in devices: orange lines

Only inside a device card: knob arcs, value bars, the selected EQ point. Everywhere else values stay grey.

Outside devices, values stay grey

Menus and focus

Do
  • Use solid orange only for something live.
  • Mark a picked option with the soft tint: a pale fill and orange text.
  • Keep orange values inside device cards.
Don’t
  • Fill a picked option with solid orange.
  • Turn a selected clip or Session slot orange: it gets an outline in ink 1.
  • Colour knobs, faders or meters orange outside a device.

Text

One typeface with fixed-width digits, so a value can change without the text around it jumping.

Geist for every word and number (400, 500, 600, 700, bundled from assets/fonts), with the font’s own tabular figures (tnum) turned on everywhere. No monospace face, no letter spacing, no capital-letter labels.

  • Set letter spacing.

The card is raised, each section is pressed in, controls sit in grooves, and the picked option rises out of its groove. Only slightly different greys, thin lines and 1–2 px shadows: no gradients, no blur, no glow.

Do
  • Keep depth inside device cards.
  • Build depth from greys, thin lines and 1–2 px shadows.
  • Keep every device card 260 high and let the width fit.
Don’t
  • Raise buttons or panels in the shell.
  • Use gradients or blur.
  • Put the pitch and mod wheels in a groove.

Buttons

Buttons have no border: they sit on the faint well. What you picked gets the soft tint; what is live gets solid orange. Inside a device, controls sit in grooves and the picked option is raised.

Tabs

Primary and destructive actions

Do
  • Show the well at rest, or on hover for icon buttons.
  • Draw a disabled cell in ink 4.
Don’t
  • Draw a border around a button.
  • Box toolbar values: they are plain text with a quieter unit.

Knobs, sliders, meters and wheels

Inside devices, knobs have a centre cap and sliders are wide value bars. Outside devices the controls stay flat and grey.

Knob

Value bar

The slider inside devices: 16 high, corner 4, in a groove. Drag anywhere; a click never jumps the value; double-click resets.

Slider

Outside devices: track volume, Master, sends. A flat 16 px bar on BgSunken with its value written inside. Hover the bars.

Wheels

Meter

Graphs

Interaction contract

  • Vertical drag, up increases, full range over about 140 px; Shift (or Ctrl / ⌘) is fine. A click never jumps the value.
  • Double-click on the control restores the default.
  • ⌥ / Alt-click, or a double-click on the read-out, types a value: the read-out turns editable −3.3dB. Enter commits, Esc cancels, Tab moves on.
  • Right-click opens the parameter menu (Type value…, Reset to default).
Do
  • Use value bars for sliders inside a device.
  • Write a shell slider’s value inside the bar.
  • Use the round wheel for pitch and mod on every instrument.
Don’t
  • Use a thin slider inside a device.
  • Put a groove under a slider outside a device.
  • Use a flat or restyled pitch and mod wheel.

Fields

Fields and menus have no border; they sit on the well like buttons. Inside a device, a field sits in a groove and a preset menu is raised.

Do

Icons

One icon set, drawn on a 24-unit grid with one line weight, so every icon matches.

Filled only where a shape needs mass to read: the transport shapes, the OS marks, a favourite star, the disclosure carets. Every icon is a kind in Controls/Glyph.cs; no unicode symbols and no emoji as text. These drawings show the rules; the app’s own glyphs are the reference for each shape.

Devices

All 50 devices of 0.56.1, plus Vocoder, are redrawn with these rules.

Every device keeps every control, label and value it had in 0.56.1, in the same groups. Each card is 260 high; the bars show each card’s width to scale (from the tables in DESIGN.md).

What changes on each
DeviceWidthWhat changes
Aurora1050Status line removed. Rail sliders become value bars; the teal modulation colour goes, so Position, Fine, Detune and Spread read like the rest. Wide so the oscillator strip fits on one line.
Bass1050Status line removed. Rail sliders become value bars; filter type in one row of four instead of a 2 × 2 grid. Wide so the filter graph keeps its frequency labels.
Consort1050Status line removed. The patch-bay row under the card goes: its cable count and Open menu move to the header, its "no cables" note is dropped. Mixer, glide and drift sliders become value bars.
Flux700Status line removed. With no source the React controls (Listen, Target, the source menu) are drawn in ink 4; the four world names lose their colours. Glide, tune and gain become value bars; React keeps its header line.
Grain700Status line removed. Read sliders become value bars; Scan speed is inactive in Freeze, so its row is ink 4.
Keys1050Status line removed. MIDI learn and the S / L switch stay in the header; Play sliders become value bars; the teal goes. Wide so the pickup window keeps its size and the pedal sits beside its label.
Monolith700No status line before either. Mixer, Ext, Feedback and Drift sliders become value bars.
Mosaic700Status line removed. MIDI learn stays in the header; Volume, Pan and Glide become value bars; the teal Vel → Vol arc turns orange like the rest.
Operator700Status line removed. Level and Global sliders become value bars; the Volume knob sits beside the meter. The teal modulator marks become grey (carrier D stays in ink 1).
Pendulum1050Status line removed. The Rate slider becomes a value bar on its own row under Free / Sync, division and Motion. The teal leads and times become grey; the ball striking a wall stays orange.
Pentad700Status line removed; the Voice menu moves up beside the Mixer and Output tabs. Mixer sliders become value bars; the flat wheels become the round wheels.
Physical700Status line removed. Tune, Fine and Note off become value bars; the teal "env → freq off" readout becomes grey.
Rhythm1050Status line removed. The Step strip sits under the Voice panel so the eight kit voices keep full-height rows. Swing, Human and Accent become value bars; the teal trigger line, playing bank and velocity lane become grey or a picked segment.
Sampler700Status line removed. Volume, Pan and Glide become value bars; Crossfade is ink 4 while the loop is off.
Synth700Status line removed. MIDI learn and the S / L toggle stay in the header after the type tag; Volume, Pan and Glide become value bars. Pulse W is ink 4 while the wave is not Square.
Volt1050Status line removed. Cutoff, Reso and Glide become value bars. The repeated knob and Route labels of the two oscillator rows become one row of column heads; the oscillator and noise knobs are large (34) in 54 px cells, and the noise colour is the dark / pink / white chips alone. Gain, Drive and Pan, and the filter knobs, are full knob cells; in the Global rail the meter stands at the right.

Dynamic EQ-81050; 702 foldedThe EQ Eight layout (below), graph 473 × 169. Each band chip carries a dynamics activity bar along its bottom. The panel is drawn like EQ-8's, in two columns on one set of rows so their parts line up: the band column (head, shapes, Freq / Gain / Q, then Key Self / Ext and Solo) beside the dynamics column (title and fold arrow, Static / Duck / Lift beside the shapes, Thresh / Range / Attack / Release as knobs beside Freq / Gain / Q, then the Dynamic switch and an inline Output knob, as EQ-8's Scale and Output). Range is a bipolar knob (left cuts, right boosts); Thresh carries the band's level as a marker. A picked but switched-off band has a grey toggle and an orange-ring graph point; the dynamics knobs are ink 4 while the band is Static. The right panel folds like EQ-8's (below).
EQ-3700Status line removed. Band faders become upright value bars around 0 dB; the band colours (rose, white, teal) become greys.
EQ-8700; 568 foldedThe EQ Eight layout (below), graph 470 × 169, with the right panel one narrow column (200) as before. Slope and Channel sit side by side under the picked band's knobs, each named underneath like a knob; Scale and Output close the column as small knobs. Analyzer and Auto gain sit over the graph's top-left corner, the auto gain in effect on the switch's word. Channel uses the short names St, M, S, L, R. The status line's draggable Out readout is the same control as the Output knob, which stays. The right column folds (below).
Flanger700Status line removed. Sliders become value bars (Feedback fills from the centre); the right channel draws in a darker grey instead of teal.

Lens700Status line removed. The Top and Range rail faders become upright value bars; Peak hold and Mid / Side share one row.

Orbit700Status line removed. Rate, Shape, Amount, Phase and Mix become value bars. The teal goes: the right channel (curve, legend, playhead dot, R tags) is a darker grey, L the curve colour.
Phaser700Status line removed. Rate, Stereo, Center, Depth, Feedback and Mix become value bars (Feedback from the middle). The teal goes as in Orbit.
Prism700Status line removed. Amount and Out faders become upright value bars; the band threshold sliders become value bars (an off band is grey). The band colours (olive, teal) go: band marks and crossovers are greys told apart by shade.

Valve1050Status line removed. Wide so five knobs and their readouts fit side by side and the five cab sizes fit in one row; Cabinet sim and Noise gate share one row. Gain and Out faders become upright value bars; Axis and Gate become value bars.

The rail is regrouped so all of it fits: Mode, then Dry / wet beside Gain and PDC, then Macro map, Fold and Save on one row; Macro map is a plain button.

Rack out puts Volume beside Glide, with Macro map, Fold and Save on one row; Macro map is a plain button.
Do
  • Keep every control, in the same groups as 0.56.1.
  • Use pressed-in sections, value bars, capped knobs and orange values inside the card.
  • Put the on/off switch at the right of every header, instruments and racks included.
Don’t
  • Add a status line under the card; a control that lived there moves into the card.
  • Use thin sliders, monospace readouts or capital-letter labels.
  • Fade anything out; draw it in ink 4 with nothing picked.

Changes from 0.56.1

For anyone building this.

What is drawn differently from Nota 0.56.1. Anything not listed stays as it is. The work lands in phases on the ui/style-guide branch; DESIGN.md § Known drift says what is not built yet.

What0.56.1Now
ToolbarEvery cell, readout and menu has its own boxNo boxes: values are plain text with a quieter unit, and thin lines split the bar into groups
TextGeist Mono for every numberGeist everywhere; numbers keep a fixed width so they don’t jump as they change; tags in sentence case
ClipsSolid track colour with a darker title band; selected clips turn orangeA pale tint of the track colour with the notes, wave and name in the full colour; a selected clip gets an outline in the text colour
Track coloursNew tracks go green, teal, sky…, so neighbours look alikeThe same nine colours in a new order so neighbours contrast: green, blue, amber, violet, rose…
Track headerThree rows of boxed controls and a pan barTwo quieter rows with every control kept, and a small pan knob
GroupsTracks in a group are indented a few pixelsA bar in the group colour runs down past every track in the group
Piano rollA narrow settings column on the left that scrollsAll the settings in one strip above the notes
Audio editorThe same narrow columnOne column at the same width (232), rearranged so nothing scrolls
Follow iconA playhead flag on a rulerA playhead with an arrow pointing right
Icon gridIcons drawn on a 16 px grid with a 1.5 px lineIcons drawn on a 24 px grid with a 1.6 px line; every icon gets redrawn
Modular nodesPorts in rows that don’t line up, so cables bend; a status dot and a bypass button; a grid of large knobsPorts on the card edges, lined up so cables run straight; a different shape per signal; one power switch; a header tinted by category; parameters as a short list of bars
DevicesBordered boxes, big gauge knobs and a status line underneathEven spacing inside the card, smaller knobs with a centre cap, the round wheels from Aurora, Bass, Operator and Volt (Pentad’s flat wheels go) and square switches, no status line
OrangeOrange for anything playing or selected, always as a solid fillThree strengths: solid for what is playing, a pale tint for what you picked, orange values inside devices
DepthRaised buttons everywhere; flat panelsOnly device cards look raised; the sections inside them look pressed in, and their controls sit in grooves
Device card sizeEvery card 700 × 260Always 260 high; the width grows to fit the device (Pentad 724, EQ-8 720, or 580 with its right panel folded)
Sliders outside devicesA 3 px line with a small cap and the value beside itA flat 16 px bar with the value written inside it, in the same family as the device value bars
Device slidersA thin line with a small handleA wider bar you can drag anywhere, with an orange line at the value
CornersSmall corners (2 to 4 px), nothing fully roundRounder corners, from 2 px on small parts up to 9 px on device cards
